follow-up time: Not specified, but children were followed up via phone interview
cohort: 140,387 pregnancies at a hospital between January 1, 2008 and July 1, 2017
finding: Placental chorioangioma increases the risk of fetal demise, pregnancy complications (preterm birth, cesarean section, polyhydramnios, and preeclampsia after controlling for preterm birth), and adverse outcomes, but no developmental complications were reported in offspring.
mod_finding: Placental chorioangioma was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
